offering_description.value: Provides hospice end-of-life care to terminally ill patients and families through its hospice unit, and residential and commercial plumbing, drain cleaning and sewer services through its plumbing unit. Hospice is paid mainly by government programs, while plumbing is sold to homeowners and businesses.

primary_products.value: water heaters; plumbing fixtures; drain cleaning equipment

primary_services.value: hospice care; drain cleaning; plumbing repair; sewer services; water heater installation

customer_segment.value: B2C: hospice patients and their families, homeowners needing plumbing service; B2B: commercial property owners and businesses needing plumbing service; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs paying for hospice care

end_markets.value: healthcare; residential home services; commercial property maintenance

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare and Medicaid payments for hospice care; service fees: plumbing and drain service calls and repairs; product sales: water heaters, fixtures and parts sold with installations; licensing or royalties: franchise fees and royalties from independent plumbing franchisees
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; product sales; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in patient referrals and service requests, sells hospice care and plumbing services; brand owner: franchises its plumbing brand to independent operators who pay royalties

geography_served.value: US national: hospice programs in many states and plumbing operations across the United States

specialization.value: diversified: hospice care and plumbing and drain services, separate businesses with different customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned hospice offices and plumbing service branches; partners / resellers: independent plumbing franchisees operating under the company brand; direct sales: physician and hospital referrals for hospice, direct booking by homeowners for plumbing
distribution_channels.category: own locations; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hospice needs Medicare certification and state licensing, plumbing is subject to local licensing and plumbing codes

divestiture_lines: P2.2: The Company’s day to day operating businesses are managed on a decentralized basis. There are few integrated business functions between the operating units and Chemed (such as sales, marketing or purchasing). Since its inception, the Company has engaged in twelve significant acquisitions or divestitures of diverse business units.
